title: Cell Growth Assay Protocol
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v64e9gw
materials: The plates were incubated at 37 °C for 1 h prior to measuring the absorbance of each sample using an iMark™ Microplate Reader (BIO-RAD, Hercules, CA, USA) at a wavelength of 490 nm.

steps.title: Seed cells in 96-well plates
steps.instruction: Seed the cells into 96‑well plates and incubate for the indicated time periods before assay.

steps.title: Add CellTiter‑96 reagent
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of CellTiter‑96® AQueous One Solution Reagent to each well.

steps.title: Measure absorbance and calculate viability
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of each well, then calculate cell viability by comparing treated‑cell absorbance to control‑cell absorbance (control defined as 100%). Perform each condition in triplicate or quadruplicate.

substeps.instruction: Compute viability relative to control (set as 100%).
Repeat each sample in triplicate or quadruplicate.
